notes: Sequence 21 adds the signed daily read-only Service Lifecycle Guardian. It inventories required/fallback/optional services, installed versions, stale baselines and integration gaps; blocks known legacy fallbacks such as pre-1.x OpenCode, but performs no automatic external software updates/removals. Current reviewed upstream baselines: runner 2.337.0, Tailscale 1.102.4, Ollama 0.34.2, Codex 0.155.1, MCP Python SDK 2.2.0, OpenCode 1.18.31.
